question_en:
The attachment shows the backpack I am currently using, but I cannot recall the specific model. I want to switch to a laptop backpack from the same brand with a similar front layout and a more suitable capacity. Please answer the following three sub-questions in order:

1. Based on the appearance in the attachment, identify the brand and specific model of the backpack.
2. Find the laptop backpack product catalog on the brand's official website. Use the basic models therein as candidates; different colors of the same product page count as only one model. Identify models that simultaneously meet the following conditions: a main compartment with a rounded or arched zipper; a flat, nearly rectangular front storage area occupying about half or more of the visible bag body; at least one visible open side pocket. Exclude roll-top, wide-flap, tote, and briefcase styles, as well as models dominated by multiple puffy small pockets and exposed webbing. Please list the names of the models that meet the conditions.
3. From the results of Question 2, using the specifications and USD prices from the same version of the product pages, retain products that can accommodate at least a 15-inch laptop and have a nominal capacity of 20–30 L. Select the top three models sorted by weight from lightest to heaviest; if weights are equal, prioritize the lower price; if still tied, sort by English name. Please provide the names, accommodated laptop screen sizes, capacities, weights, and prices of the final three models.

Answer format: For Question 1, provide the brand and model in text; for Question 2, list all visually matching models in text; for Question 3, list the final three models in a table in the specified order with columns for name, accommodated laptop screen size, capacity, weight, and price, noting units in the table headers.
answer:
Question 1: Brand: Timbuk2; Model: Q Laptop Backpack 2.0.

Question 2: Division Laptop Backpack Deluxe; Authority Laptop Backpack Deluxe; Q Laptop Backpack 2.0; Never Check Expandable Backpack; Custom Division Laptop Backpack; Parker Commuter Backpack; Lane Commuter Backpack; Parkside Laptop Backpack 2.0; Water Resistant Division Backpack.

| Authority Laptop Backpack Deluxe | 17 | 20 | 1100 | 179.00 |
| Never Check Expandable Backpack | 15 | 21 | 1180 | 249.00 |

## Step 01 · inspect_image / Recover brand and model from the current backpack front view

Action: Observe the top arched zipper, carry handle, wide front panel, lower horizontal pocket, and side pocket openings.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): The text "TIMBUK2" is readable at the bottom of the current input; the model name is not displayed. The front is black, featuring a large low-profile rectangular area on the upper part, a horizontal pocket below, and visible bag body opening edges on both sides. The brand text supports only Timbuk2; the specific model still requires verification against official images.

Result of this step: Use Timbuk2 as the candidate brand and match product models using geometric layout.

## Step 02 · search + open_image / Corresponding to Q Laptop Backpack 2.0

Action: Example query: "site:timbuk2.com Q Laptop Backpack 2.0 front black"; compare the carry handle, front panel stitching, and lower pocket boundary with the default front image on the official website.
